description: This file contains test utility functions for creating and managing test data such as users, blocks, cards, and boards, as well as helper functions for extracting IDs, used in testing the store layer of the focalboard project.

methods.name: createTestUsers
methods.description: Creates a specified number of test users with unique IDs and emails.

methods.name: createTestBlocks
methods.description: Creates a specified number of test blocks associated with a user.

methods.name: createTestBlocksForCard
methods.description: Creates text blocks associated with a specific card.

methods.name: createTestCards
methods.description: Creates a specified number of test card blocks within a board.

methods.name: createTestBoards
methods.description: Creates a specified number of test boards within a team.

methods.name: deleteTestBoard
methods.description: Deletes a test board by ID.

methods.name: extractIDs
methods.description: Extracts and sorts IDs from various struct slices for comparison in tests.
